UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Workshop owner account profile, single-device binding metadata, and security preferences stored per Firebase UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching document ID.

identifier.description: Email address or normalized mobile number.

pinHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of 4-digit app PIN.

cnicHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of normalized 13-digit CNIC.

cnicLast4.description: Last 4 digits of CNIC for Admin display.

mobileHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of normalized mobile number.

kycDuplicateOf.description: Original UID if flagged as duplicate CNIC.

activeDeviceId.description: Currently active bound mobile/device ID for single-device enforcement.

activeDeviceName.description: Display name of the currently active device.

activeSessionId.description: Active session ID; mismatch auto-logs out previous device.

activeDeviceCount.description: Count of active sessions currently authorized (0 or 1).

sessionVersion.description: Monotonically incremented counter to revoke all active sessions immediately.

lastLoginAt.description: Epoch ms of latest approved device login.

totalKhataAmount.description: Cached workshop total bill amount for Admin summary.

totalPendingAmount.description: Cached total pending balance for Admin summary.

customerCount.description: Cached customer count for Admin summary.

lastSyncAt.description: Epoch ms of last cloud sync.

lastBackupAt.description: Epoch ms of last cloud backup snapshot.

UserVaultDoc.title: UserVaultDoc
UserVaultDoc.description: Segmented workshop data shard under users/{userId}/vault/{docId} (core, ledger, operations, kyc) to stay well under Firestore 1MB doc limit.

docType.description: Shard type: core, ledger, operations, or kyc.

payloadJson.description: Serialized JSON payload for the shard.

UserBackupSnapshot.title: UserBackupSnapshot
UserBackupSnapshot.description: Daily automatic or manual full cloud backup snapshot under users/{userId}/backups/{backupId}.

payloadJson.description: Serialized JSON snapshot of workshop data.

createdAt.description: Epoch ms when snapshot was recorded.

UserDevice.title: UserDevice
UserDevice.description: Trusted or revoked mobile/device record under users/{userId}/devices/{deviceId}.

deviceId.description: Unique persistent device ID matching doc ID.

isActive.description: Whether this device currently holds the single active session.

sessionId.description: Current session identifier on this device.

approvedAt.description: Epoch ms when owner approved this device.

lastSeenAt.description: Epoch ms of latest device activity.

LoginHistoryEntry.title: LoginHistoryEntry
LoginHistoryEntry.description: Audit log of every Allowed or Blocked login attempt under users/{userId}/loginHistory/{entryId}.

id.description: Log entry ID matching doc ID.

deviceId.description: Device ID associated with this attempt.

isUnknown.description: True when device name could not be identified.

DeviceApprovalLink.title: DeviceApprovalLink
DeviceApprovalLink.description: Indefinite owner email approval request for new/unrecognized devices under deviceApprovalLinks/{reqId}. No timeout expiry.

decision.description: Approval state; remains pending until owner explicitly clicks ALLOW or NOT ALLOW.

tokenHash.description: 32-byte SHA-256 digest of the secret email action token.

approvalToken.description: Empty on create; populated with matching raw token when resolved via owner link.

createdAt.description: Epoch ms when approval request was created.

decidedAt.description: Epoch ms when owner decided (0 while pending).

CnicClaim.title: CnicClaim
CnicClaim.description: Global SHA-256 hashed 13-digit CNIC uniqueness lock ensuring strictly 1 CNIC = 1 Account without storing raw CNIC PII in shared lookup.

cnicHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of normalized 13-digit CNIC without dashes.

createdAt.description: Epoch ms when CNIC was registered.

MobileClaim.title: MobileClaim
MobileClaim.description: Global SHA-256 hashed normalized mobile uniqueness lock ensuring strictly 1 Mobile = 1 Account.

mobileHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of normalized mobile digits.

createdAt.description: Epoch ms when mobile was registered.

structure.description: Owner profile, active device binding, and security metadata scoped to userId == request.auth.uid or Admin.
Domain-sharded workshop data (core, ledger, operations, kyc) scoped to userId == request.auth.uid or Admin read.
Auto daily 12AM and manual cloud backup snapshots scoped to userId == request.auth.uid or Admin read.
Approved/revoked device records for single-device binding scoped to userId == request.auth.uid or Admin.
Login attempt audit log (Allowed/Blocked) scoped to userId == request.auth.uid or Admin.
Capability-link approval documents verified via SHA-256 tokenHash for ALLOW / NOT ALLOW owner email links.
Single-account CNIC hash claim enforcing 1 CNIC = 1 Account.
Single-account mobile hash claim enforcing 1 Mobile = 1 Account.
